name: MobileNetV3-Small U-Net ROI, 9 l?p gi?y t?

roi_segmenter.onnx.name: mask_logits
roi_segmenter.onnx.postprocess: sigmoid >= 0.45, bounding rectangle + 4% horizontal and 8% vertical margins

cccd_preprocessing: Training used grayscale page and crop for CCCD. Browser runs RGB first; if initial class is CCCD, it reruns segmentation and classification on grayscale page/crop.
browser_pipeline: letterbox full page to 256x256; RGB ImageNet normalization
threshold mask at 0.45 and map its bounding rectangle from letterbox coordinates to original image
crop original page at predicted rectangle and letterbox to 224x224
run roi_classifier.onnx and softmax the nine logits
if initial class is cccd, grayscale full page and crop and rerun segmenter and classifier
notes: Static inference handoff. The training run was stopped at epoch 28; best checkpoint from epoch 27 is packaged. Test split was not run for this checkpoint.
